page.overview:
What is Paighon?

Paighon is a fictional entity which appears in the Lovecraftian fiction of the late American author Walter C. DeBill, Jr.

Described as a "nuclear force-creature" (: "The Barrett Horror"), Paighon is possibly a Great Old One or an Elder God. In "Collector's Item", the earliest of DeBill's works it appears in, Paighon is said to have come from the Andromeda galaxy to the Solar System and settled inside the core of the Earth soon after it formed.

Paighon is the deadly enemy of Ngyr-Khorath and its servitor, 'Ymnar. (: "The Barrett Horror")
